items.docs:
Update an existing origin request. Only requests in `Requested` status can be updated.
At least one of `requestedWeight` or `endDate` must be provided.
- `requestedWeight` — update the requested weight for the origin request.
- `endDate` — update the end date for the origin request.


**Required permission:** `access_public_products`

params.name: originRequestId
params.description: The ID of the origin request.

items.docs:
The request can be closed only if it is in `Requested` status.
Closing the request prevents any further updates or actions on it.
Once closed, the request status is set to `Answered` or `Canceled`:
- **Answered** — at least one origin has been provided for the request.
- **Canceled** — no origins have been provided for the request.


**Required permission:** `access_public_products`

Send origin requests for products to suppliers. Suppliers are notified by in-app notification and email.
Additional email CCs and a comment can be provided in the payload.
Every supplier must have at least one contact to be notified.
To manage and fetch contacts, use the connection-contact endpoints.


**Required permission:** `access_public_products`

info.name: Fetch customer origin requests per inbound product

items.docs:
Retrieve a paginated list of origin requests for a specific inbound product.

Returns origin requests created for the product, with optional filtering by reference and status.
Each item includes status details when the request is answered, delayed, or rejected.

**Use Cases**:
- View all origin requests for a product
- Track request status and supplier responses
- Filter requests by reference or status

**Pagination**:
- Results are paginated (default: 10 items per page)
- Use `page` and `size`
